note: vramGiB is binary (2^30 bytes) because that is what the hardware actually has: a '24 GB' RTX 3090 reports 24576 MiB. bandwidthGBs and fp16Tflops are decimal, because that is how vendors specify them. fp16Tflops is dense throughput without structured sparsity. usableFraction is the share an inference process can allocate.
